children: Multicoin Capital partner Shayon Sengupta said on September 29 that Multicoin has invested in decentralized bandwidth network Grass through both its hedge fund and venture fund. According to ChainCatcher, Grass is positioning itself as a read layer for machine intelligence and has spent about 18 months using crypto incentives to recruit contributors to share idle bandwidth for querying and parsing the public internet.

Grass said more than 6 million contributors have received dollar-denominated rewards funded by revenue generated directly from their contributions. The company reported $17 million in revenue in 2025 and another $17 million in the first half of 2026, with nearly all AI customers returning, and said it is profitable. It also guided to $75 million in training-data revenue alone for 2026, based on figures shared in a July 7 call with token holders and network participants.

Sengupta said Grass plans to launch a Contents API that would let models open and render public pages through residential networks, along with a Search API and web indexing. Grass has also collected more than 1 billion public web videos, some of which are being used with Multicoin portfolio company Inference.net to train video annotation models.

title: Multicoin Capital Invests in Grass as Network Reports Revenue Growth
